checks.name: Compact brand followed immediately by live session, with navigation after the first meaningful value
All original live numbers and impact amounts match V3.2.4 in both layouts and all five regions
Today equals component net rates since local midnight, with explicit date, time zone and model label
Local-day calculation handles the 25-hour autumn daylight-saving days in Berlin and New York
2035 card reproduces the selected S-curve or linear scenario and opens the existing timeline without resetting visit time
New copy is available in all ten languages and region controls remain coupled
Mobile timeline still has bars, year slider, region switch, info and assumptions in that order; other region controls retain requested positions
Steady mobile updates create no display elements and retain featured, today and fuel/CO2 nodes
Native share captures model context and a canonical public link, without automatically sharing
Today sharing contains local date/time context and BEV model wording; copy fallback reports success only after copying
The single page share link restores region, language, selected year, curve and saturation; invalid params are ignored or normalized
Manual fallback works without sharing or clipboard; cancelling native share does not copy anything
Model parameters, source history and scenario formulas remain unchanged except release version metadata
Exactly one share button appears at the end of the homepage; no share controls in the entry or insight cards
IDs are unique and the main method deep links remain functional

kind: DOM simulation, numerical comparison and mocked sharing APIs
limits: No graphical browser rendering or physical iPhone test.
